---
title: "The register"
---

[Mannanafnaskrá](https://island.is/leit-i-mannanafnaskra) is the register of Icelandic
given and middle names, kept by Þjóðskrá (Registers Iceland). Every name the Icelandic
Naming Committee has ruled on is in it, with who it is for.

## What is bundled

A snapshot of the whole register ships in `src/kyngreinir/data/mannanafnaskra.csv`, about
5,900 names:

```{.csv filename="mannanafnaskra.csv"}
id,icelandicName,type,status,verdict,url
2461,helga,ST,Sam,,
789,ingimundur,DR,Sam,,
```

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `icelandicName` | the name, in lowercase |
| `type` | `DR`/`RDR` a boy's name (*drengjanafn*), `ST`/`RST` a girl's name (*stúlknanafn*); anything else, such as `MI` (*millinafn*), is not gendered |
| `status` | `Sam` approved, `Haf` rejected |
| `verdict` | the date of the committee's ruling, if any |
| `url` | a link to the ruling, if any |

A name registered both as a boy's and as a girl's name is unisex.

Rejected names are kept by default: a rejected name is still evidence of the gender it was
proposed for. Pass
`approved_only=True` to `Register` to use approved names only.

## Refreshing it

```bash
kyngreinir registry-fetch -o src/kyngreinir/data/mannanafnaskra.csv
```

About 30 requests to island.is, under a minute: one substring search per letter of the
Icelandic alphabet, deduplicated by id.

To use a fresh copy without replacing the bundled one, pass it with `--register`:

```bash
kyngreinir registry-fetch -o my-register.csv
kyngreinir name "Helga Ingimundardóttir" --register my-register.csv
```

## How it is read

There is no documented public API or bulk download for the register. Its search page calls
an unauthenticated GraphQL endpoint, and `kyngreinir.registry.search()` calls the same
endpoint directly, with the headers the site's own search box sends.

::: {.callout-note}
## If `registry-fetch` stops working

The search uses a persisted-query hash that the island.is page sends. If island.is changes
the query, every search fails with `PersistedQueryNotFound`. Open the register's search
page, search for anything, find the `GetIcelandicNameBySearch` request in the browser's
network tab, and copy its `sha256Hash` into `PERSISTED_SHA256` in `registry.py`.

Classifying is not affected: it only reads the bundled snapshot.
:::
